source: 767 Underworld
target: 767 Orcus

source: With Lumian vanishing before the crystal skull, the human skulls, already covered in countless cracks, lost their support.
target: Cum Lumian coram cranio crystallino evanuerit, crania humana, iam innumeris fissuris tecta, subsidium suum amisissent.

source: They shattered with a thunderous crash, bringing down the shadows from above and splitting the grassy wilderness into fragments.
target: Illi cum fragore tonitruoso confracta sunt, umbras ex alto detrahendo et solitudinem virentem in frusta dividendo.

source: Oxyto’s Paramita crumbled toward the cracked crystal skull, and everything there silently turned to dust.
target: Paramita Oxytoni corruit ad cranio crystallino fissum, et omnia ibi silentio in pulverem conversa sunt.

source: The spirits dissipated, the light vanished, and the void of darkness swallowed everything.
target: Spiritus dissipati sunt, lux evanuit, et vacuitas tenebrarum omnia absorpsit.

source: No one knew how much time had passed before a gentle light began to glow in the absolute blackness, revealing a barren, dim, pale, and almost frozen wilderness.
target: Nemo scivit quantum temporis elapsum esset, donec lenis lumen in absoluta tenebris inciperet scintillare, revelans solitudinem sterilem, obscuram, pallidam, et paene gelidam.

source: In the center of the wasteland lay the tranquil and sacred Lake Dalsh.
target: In medio vastitatis iacebat lacus Dalsh, tranquillus et sacer.

source: The headless lady, draped in a dark‐black dress and carrying four heads, swiftly appeared beside the lake, quietly gazing at its serene, transparent surface.
target: Mulier capite carens, induta veste nigro atra et quattuor capita gerens, celeriter apparuit iuxta lacum, leniter intuens eius serenum et perspicuum superficiem.

source: As soon as Lumian was pulled through the bronze door, he felt countless eyes upon him, chilling his body further and numbing him.
target: Quam primum Lumian per ianuam aeneam trahitus est, sensit innumeros oculos in se versantes, qui corpus eius ulterius refrigerabant atque imbecillabant.

source: Meanwhile, arms of unknown origin reached out, grabbing at his head, neck, torso, and legs.
target: Interim, bracchia originis ignotae extendebantur, caput, collum, pectus, et crura eius rapientes.

source: Some had dull skin with white, bony teeth; others were so decayed that their flesh was falling off, slowly wriggling with equally decayed worms; some lacked skin altogether; others were merely illusory Spirit Bodies…
target: Aliqui habebant cute opacam cum dentibus albis et ossibus; alii tam corrupti erant ut caro eorum cadebat, lente se contorcendo cum vermibus similiter corruptis; quidam cutis omnino caret; alii tantum erant corpora spirituum illusoria.

source: What they all shared was a bone‐chilling cold that could freeze the soul.
target: Quod omnes communicabant, erat frigus ex ossibus, quod animam congelare posset.

source: On Lumian’s face, the golden mask painted with black and white oil sparkled with a faint yet pure light.
target: In facie Lumiani, persona aurea, nigro et albo oleo picta, luce tenuissima sed pura micabat.

source: The reaching arms halted momentarily before retracting.
target: Bracchia extendentia paulisper cessaverunt antequam retracta erant.

source: The eyes watching him from the darkness also withdrew their gaze.
target: Oculi, qui eum ex tenebris observabant, quoque suum intuitum retraxerunt.

source: Lumian regained his thoughts and his sense of his body.
target: Lumian cogitationes suas atque sensum corporis sui recuperavit.

source: Below him, he discovered a deep pit with no visible bottom or boundaries.
target: Sub eum invenit foveam profundam sine fundo vel limitibus visibilibus.

source: The edge of the pit was made up of layers of blurry worlds, spiraling downward to the limits of his vision.
target: Limen fossae constabat ex stratis orbium nebulosorum, spiraliter descendens ad terminos visionis eius.

source: These jumbled worlds layered atop each other, and Lumian couldn’t make out what lay within them, only knowing that each was vaster than the Star Highlands, with all previous watching eyes stemming from the pit’s bottomless dark.
target: Hi mundos confusos uno super alium involutos erant, et Lumian non poterat perspicere quid in illis iaceret, nisi quod sciebat unusquisque vastior esse quam Montes Stellarum, cum omnibus antea observantibus oculis ex fundo foveae insondabilis provenientibus.

source: Lumian plummeted suddenly, falling into one of these blurry worlds in the blink of an eye.
target: Subito Lumian praecipitatus est, in unum ex his orbibus nebulosis in ictu oculi cadens.

source: Miraculously, he stood on a barren wilderness exposed with gray‐white rocks, surrounded by heaps of bleached bones, densely packed and stretching toward various distant places.
target: Miracose stetit in desolata terra, patefacta lapidibus cinereo‐albis, circumdata congeries ossium candidorum, densissime compacta atque in varias regiones longinquas extendens.

source: At this moment, these bones lay still, as if slumbering through time.
target: Hoc ipso momento, ossa illa quieta iacebant, quasi per tempus dormientes.

source: Is this the Underworld?
target: Hicne est Orcus?

source: I wonder where the Abscessed Hand’s body part might be.
target: Miror ubi pars corporis Manus Abscessae sit.

source: Lumian looked around, muttering to himself in silence.
target: Lumian circumspiciebat, silentio sibi submurmurans.

source: (Amonoculus’ note: It is the contracted creature that gave him the traverse the Spirit World. Lumian must find its body parts or else he cannot achieve godhood. According to Fors, one of the body parts is located in the Underworld.)
target: (Nota Amonoculi: Creatura contracta est, quae ei viam per Mundi Spirituum dedit. Lumian eius partes corporis invenire debet, alioquin deitatem adipisci non poterit. Secundum Fors, una ex partibus corporis in Orco sita est.)

source: It was the chance to enter the Underworld that had prompted him to help voluntarily, using the Eggers family’s golden mask and the Underworld Daoist’s seal to push open the bronze door inside the crystal skull.
target: Haec occasio intrandi Orcum eum impulit ut voluntarie adiuvareret, utens persona aurea familiae Eggers et sigillo Daoista Orci ad aperiendum ianuam aeneam intra cranio crystallino.

source: Now, the problem was that the Underworld was much more vast than he had anticipated, and he had no idea where to start looking.
target: Iam quaestio erat quod Orcus multo vasta esset quam praevidisset, atque nesciebat quo inciperet quaerere.

source: Similarly, the whereabouts and intentions of the decaying infant that Oxyto had sent were unknown.
target: Similiter, loca et intentiones infantis corrupti, quem Oxyto miserat, ignota erant.

source: Perhaps I could rely on the contract I had signed with the Abscessed Hand.
target: Fortasse in pacto, quem cum Manu Abscessae signeram, confiderem.

source: Essentially being part of the same body, they are mystically connected.
target: Essentialiter, eo quod pars eiusdem corporis sunt, mystice inter se connexi sunt.

source: The contract I had signed is, to some extent, also with the rest of its body…
target: Pactum, quod signeram, est, ad aliquod modum, etiam cum reliqua eius corpore.

source: Lumian quickly formulated a plan and spoke in a cold, hoarse voice, “Knight of Swords, have all of you entered as well?”
target: Lumian celeriter consilium suum composuit ac frigida, rauca voce dixit: “Eques Gladii, vos omnes quoque intrastisne?”

source: “Yes,” came the faint voice of the Knight of Swords, Maric.
target: “Ita,” respondit vox tenue Eques Gladii, Maric.

source: Pausing momentarily, he added, “A companion of mine has also entered.”
target: Paulisper cessato, addidit: “Socius meus quoque intravit.”

source: Lumian nodded.
target: Lumian annuit.

source: “Why aren’t both of you coming out? You are now in a wraith state, so there’s no need to worry about dying instantly in the Underworld.”
target: “Cur non egressi estis ambo? Nunc in statu umbrarum estis, itaque non opus est timere mortem instantem in Orco.”

source: “You’re essentially undead beings now; what’s there to fear about the Underworld’s unique conditions?”
target: “Vos enim nunc quasi mortui estis; quid timendum est de singularibus condicionibus Orci?”

source: The Knight of Swords responded, “But we are fundamentally still living beings. If we stay in the Underworld as wraiths for too long, we won’t be able to revert to human form and will forever exist as wraiths or evil spirits. By using your body, we can temporarily avoid the influence of the Underworld, emerging only when it’s crucial.”
target: Eques Gladii respondit: “Sed tamen nos fundamentatim sumus entia viventia. Si in Orco nimis diu in statu umbrarum maneamus, non poterimus ad formam humanam redire et in perpetuum ut umbrae aut spiritus mali exsistere. Corpus tuum utendo, incursionem Orci temporarie vitare possumus, emergentes solum cum necessarium est.”

source: “I see…” Lumian looked up at the pale, dim sky, “I also can’t wear this Eggers family’s mask for too long. We have about three hours.”
target: “Intelligo…” Lumian ad caelum pallidum et obscurum aspiciebat, “ego quoque hanc personam auream familiae Eggers nimis diu portare non possum. Habemus circiter tres horas.”

source: As he spoke, Lumian tried to activate without using the black mark on his right shoulder, which was the Abscessed Hand’s Spirit World Traversal ability.
target: Dum loquebatur, Lumian conatus est activare sine utendo signo nigro in umero dextro, qui erat facultas transitus Mundi Spirituum a Manu Abscessae.

source: With this mark, he faintly sensed something at the end of the wilderness on his right calling to him.
target: Hac nota, leviter sensit aliquid in fine solitudinis dextro, quod ei vocabat.

source: Is that the body part of the Abscessed Hand in the Underworld?
target: Num haec pars corporis Manu Abscessae in Orco est?

source: Just as Lumian had this thought, a figure appeared ahead.
target: Justo cum hoc Lumian cogitaverat, figura ante eum apparuit.

source: It was an extremely delicate‐looking young woman with an unnaturally pale complexion.
target: Erat iuvenis mulier, nimis delicata, quae cutem insolitam pallidam habebat.

source: Her deep blue eyes were profound and devoid of any emotional fluctuation; her light golden hair was tied in an astern bun adorned with a small black bonnet with a fine black veil, and she wore a complicated, exquisite black Gothic court dress.
target: Oculi eius caerulei profundissimi erant, carentes ullam motum animi; capilli eius aurei levi toni in coque retro congregati erant, ornati parvo nigro bonnet cum subtili nigro velamine, et gerebat vestem Gothicam nigram intricatam atque exquisitam.

source: Is this the temperance faction demigod that was attached to me earlier?
target: Hacne est semideus factionis temperantiae, qui ante mihi aderat?

source: Lumian recalled the two blurry figures he saw through the crystalline ice.
target: Lumian recordatus est duarum figurarum nebulosarum, quas per glaciem crystallinam vidit.

source: One of them matched the lady before him perfectly!
target: Una eorum perfecte conveniebat cum muliere coram eo!

source: The temperance faction demigod floated in mid‐air, slowly turned around, and then pointed in a direction, nodding at Lumian.
target: Semidea factionis temperantiae in aere fluitavit, lente se circumvertit, deinde in quandam partem indicavit, Lumiano annuens.

source: She was pointing toward the end of the wilderness on the right.
target: Ea indicabat versus finem solitudinis in dextro.

source: “Do you mean that Oxyto’s prematurely born, decayed child might be over there?” Lumian asked for confirmation.
target: “Num significas quod filius Oxytoni, ante tempus natus et corruptus, illic sit?” quaesivit Lumian ad confirmationem.

source: The lady in the black bonnet nodded gently in affirmation.
target: Mulier in nigro bonnet leniter annuit in affirmatione.

source: She then vanished into thin air, and Lumian felt another chill inside him.
target: Deinde illa in aere evanuit, et Lumian in se alium frigus sensit.

source: It’s all in that direction, huh… A coincidence? No, not a coincidence, it’s more likely that something in that direction is drawing them there…
target: Omnia in illa parte sunt… Casusne? Non, minime; verisimiliter aliquid illā parte eos allicit.

source: Lumian turned his body, ready to teleport to the edge of his vision.
target: Lumian corpus vertit, paratus ad teletransportandum ad limen visionis suae.

source: As soon as Lumian started to become transparent, his body was suddenly grabbed by pale hands that appeared out of nowhere, seizing his arms.
target: Quam primum Lumian transparentem fieri coepit, corpus eius subito ab manibus pallidis, ex nihilo apparente, arripiebatur, quae brachia eius ceperunt.

source: Lumian felt a paralyzing sensation throughout his body, as if his soul was being torn apart by an invisible force.
target: Lumian sensit per totum corpus eius sensum paralyticum, quasi anima eius a vi invisibili discerperetur.

source: This time, the faint glow from the golden mask had no effect.
target: Hoc tempore, tenuis fulgor ex persona aurea nullum effectum habuit.

source: Lumian attempted to ignite a blazing white flame to ward off the cold, stiffness, and numbness, but he was overwhelmed by an invisible terror, trembling uncontrollably, unable to respond effectively.
target: Lumian conatus est ignem albidum flammans accendere ut frigus, rigorem ac insensibilitatem expelleret, sed invisibili terrore superatus, incontenabiliter tremens, non potuit efficaciter responde.

source: When he regained his clarity and composure, he found himself still standing in the same spot, but surrounding layers of bleached bones had all risen up, encircling him as if to protect him.
target: Cum claritatem et temperantiam recuperavit, se in eodem loco adhuc stantem invenit, sed omnia circumjacentia strata ossium candidorum surrexerant, eum circumdantes quasi ad protegendum.

source: At the same time, Lumian heard the voice of the Knight of Swords, Maric: “Once you put on the Eggers family’s mask and become a pure undead being, you will also possess all the traits of an undead, one of which is being suppressed by higher beings of the Death pathway, making it difficult to resist and your body and mind willing to accept enslavement.
target: Simul, Lumian vocem Eques Gladii, Maric audivit dicentem: “Cum indueris personam auream familiae Eggers et fies purum entia mortuorum, omnes proprietates entis mortuorum habebis, quarum una est subiectio a superioribus entibus viae Mortis, quae difficultatem praebet resistendi et corpus ac mentem ad servitutem subeundam paratam reddit.

source: In contrast, we wraiths, who aren’t pure and can switch states freely, are less affected.”
target: ’Contra, nos umbrae, qui non sumus purae et statum libere mutare possumus, minus afficimur.’

source: Was this why I couldn’t resist just now? I wonder if the Sword of Courage can counteract this effect. It theoretically should… Lumian realized with a start. “Did both of you save me just now?”
target: Hocne est cur nunc non potui resistere? Miror num Gladius Fortitudinis hunc effectum compensare possit. Theoretice id agere debet… Lumian subito intellexit: “Num uterque me modo servavit?”

source: The Knight of Swords didn’t continue on this topic but instead reminded Lumian, “It seems that in the Underworld, you can teleport but not teleport freely, as that is considered a desecration of Death and attracts the punishment of the Underworld”
target: Eques Gladii non prosequebatur de hac re sed Lumian admonuit: “Videtur in Orco te posse teletransportari, sed non libere, quoniam id putatur profanatio Mortis et supplicium Orci attrahit.”

source: According to the mystic knowledge mentioned by Madam Magician, teleporting should be normal in the Underworld since it stems from the spirit world, but considering it as desecration of Death seems a bit too strict, typical of the oppression by higher-ranking beings of the Death pathway…
target: Secundum mysticam scientiam a Domina Magica enuntiata, teletransportatio in Orco esse debet ordinaria, cum ex mundo spirituum proveniat, sed id tamquam profanatio Mortis existimari videtur, nimis stricte, quod typicum est oppressionis a superioribus entibus viae Mortis.

source: Lumian pondered for a few seconds, slightly bending his back.
target: Lumian per paucos secundos meditatus est, leviter dorsum suum flectens.

source: A blazing white, radiant spear of flame immediately shot forth, illuminating the pale, dim half‐sky, casting towards the far reaches of the wilderness.
target: Hasta ignis albae fulgida statim emissus est, caelum pallidum et obscurum semi-illuminans, versus longinquos fines solitudinis iaculans.

source: As the white and red trail of the flame spear disappeared inch by inch, Lumian, transformed into the spear, hurled himself forward at the fastest speed he could achieve.
target: Dum vestigia alba et rubra hastae flammae per passus paulatim evanuerunt, Lumian, in hastam conversus, se in maximam celeritatem propulit.

source: During this process, he noticed the wilderness sloped downwards, and the destination he, the Knight of Swords, and the temperance faction demigod aimed for was at the bottom of this ‘hillside’.
target: In hoc processu animadvertit solitudinem declivem esse, et destinatio qua quaerebant ille, Eques Gladii, et semidea factionis temperantiae, in imo huius “collis” mansit.

source: After a while, the blazing white light scattered in all directions, and Lumian, now clad in a thick jacket, descended toward the ground.
target: Post aliquod tempus, lux flammea albae in omnia se dispersit, et Lumian, nunc indutus veste spessa, ad terram descendit.

source: Ahead of him lay a wide, surreal black river, so vast he couldn’t see the other side.
target: Ante eum iacebat flumen nigrum, latum et quasi irreale, tam vastum ut alterum latus videre non posset.

source: The river flowed silently from the edge of the sky to its limits, exceptionally quiet.
target: Flumen silentio fluebat ab orsa caeli usque ad fines eius, eximie quietum.

source: “Is this the River Styx?” Lumian inquired of the temperance faction demigod within him.
target: “Hicne est flumen Styx?” inquit Lumian semideae factionis temperantiae intra se.

source: Responding to Lumian was still the Knight of Swords, Maric: “It should be. It spans every layer of the Underworld. Crossing it is like entering the depths of the Underworld. If you hadn’t stopped earlier and ended up flying above it, you would have fallen straight into the river, and no one would have been able to pull you out.”
target: Respondens ad Lumian, Eques Gladii, Maric dixit: “Id esse debet; omnes stratos Orci complectitur. Illud transire quasi in interiores Orci intrare est. Si non antea destiteris et super illud volaveris, recte in flumen caderes, neque quis te extrahere potuisset.”

source: Good thing the issue with teleporting just now gave me a warning: it’s best to pause in uncertain environments…
target: Bene quod quaestio teletransportationis modo mihi monitum dedit: optimum est in ambitu incerto paulisper morari…

source: Lumian glanced left and right, noticing the wilderness was dotted with withered blood flowers, each concealing a multitude of corpses, bones, and shadows.
target: Lumian ad sinistram et dexteram respexit, animadvertens solitudinem punctatam esse floribus sanguine exaridorum, quorum unusquisque multitudinem cadaverum, ossium, et umbrarum celabat.

source: “How do I cross?” Lumian sensed that the missing part of the Abscessed Hand’s body was on the other side of the River Styx.
target: “Quomodo transibo?” sensit Lumian quod pars corporis Manu Abscessae deest, in altera parte fluminis Styx.

source: No sooner had he asked, and before the Knight of Swords could respond, a dilapidated, gloomy black boat suddenly appeared on the shadowy river.
target: Nisi mox postquam quaesivit, et antequam Eques Gladii respondebat, navis nigra, labefacta et lugubris, subito in flumine umbrato apparuit.

source: A figure draped in fragments stood on the boat, rowing with a long oar, guiding the vessel to Lumian’s side before stopping at the river’s edge.
target: Figura in fragmentis vestita in nave stabat, longa remo remigans, navem ad latus Lumiani gubernans, antequam ad limen fluminis sisteret.

source: Peering closely, Lumian saw that the ferryman was a severely decayed male corpse.
target: Intuens attente, Lumian vidit nautarum esse cadaver virum graviter corruptum.

source: Large portions of his body were exposed, and his eyes appeared gouged out, leaving hollow sockets entwined with thick blood vessels oozing yellow pus.
target: Magnae partes corporis eius patefactae erant, et oculi eius quasi expulsi videbantur, relinquentes orbitas cavatas, intricatas cum crassis vasculis sanguine luteo suppurante.

source: “Take this boat across?” Lumian asked, lowering his voice to consult the temperance faction member inside him.
target: “Hoc navigium transi?” quaesivit Lumian, vocem deminuens ut consuleret cum membro semideae factionis temperantiae interiori.

source: Knight of Swords Maric replied in an ethereal but slightly grave tone, “It’s the only way… But be careful of the boatman. The Underworld has mutated, and it could be affected too.”
target: Eques Gladii Maric respondit voce aetherea sed paulo gravis: “Hoc solum est iter… Sed cave nautae; Orcus mutatus est, et ipse affici potest.”
